   239→          "description": "Implements the deterministic, public custody group selection algorithm. Given a node ID and a desired number of custody groups, it computes which custody groups the node is responsible for using a hash-based pseudo-random selection. The selection is stable: increasing custody_group_count extends the existing set rather than reshuffling.",

   265→              "name": "get_custody_groups",
   266→              "signature": "def get_custody_groups(node_id: NodeID, custody_group_count: uint64) -> Sequence[CustodyIndex]",
   267→              "description": "Deterministically computes which custody groups a node with the given node_id should custody, based on hash(uint_to_bytes(current_id)) modulo NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS. Handles overflow by wrapping current_id from UINT256_MAX to 0.",
   268→              "parameters": [
   269→                {
   270→                  "name": "node_id",
   271→                  "type": "NodeID",
   272→                  "description": "The public node identifier used to seed the pseudo-random selection."
   273→                },

   275→                  "name": "custody_group_count",
   276→                  "type": "uint64",
   277→                  "description": "The number of custody groups to select. Must be <= NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS."

   280→              "returns": "Sequence[CustodyIndex] - a sorted list of unique custody group indices",
   281→              "body": "def get_custody_groups(node_id: NodeID, custody_group_count: uint64) -> Sequence[CustodyIndex]:\n    assert custody_group_count <= NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS\n\n    # Skip computation if all groups are custodied\n    if custody_group_count == NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS:\n        return [CustodyIndex(i) for i in range(NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS)]\n\n    current_id = uint256(node_id)\n    custody_groups: List[CustodyIndex] = []\n    while len(custody_groups) < custody_group_count:\n        custody_group = CustodyIndex(\n            bytes_to_uint64(hash(uint_to_bytes(current_id))[0:8]) % NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS\n        )\n        if custody_group not in custody_groups:\n            custody_groups.append(custody_group)\n        if current_id == UINT256_MAX:\n            # Overflow prevention\n            current_id = uint256(0)\n        else:\n            current_id += 1\n\n    assert len(custody_groups) == len(set(custody_groups))\n    return sorted(custody_groups)"
